description: Canonical AppState schema for ppxai. Golden source of truth for cross-language state field definitions. Loaded at startup by Python (ppxai/engine/app_state.py), Web (via window.APP_STATE_SCHEMA injected into index.html), and VSCode (bundled at vscode-extension/resources/app-state-schema.json, kept in sync by a pre-compile script). DO NOT hand-edit field maps in any client; edit this file only.

auto_route.doc: Auto-route coding tasks to a specialized model

context_attachments.doc: List of attachment summaries currently in session.messages. Entry schema: {name, kind, media_type, turn_index, file_id}

model_supports_vision.doc: Whether the active model accepts image_url content parts natively (per model_profiles.supports_vision). Pushed via SSE on every model switch. Clients use this to gate the attach button (passive badge) and warn when the user attaches an image to a non-vision model. False is the conservative default for unregistered models.

agent_beat.doc: P0 (v1.18.0) latest agent heartbeat state. Entry schema: {iteration, beat, tool, ok, failures, elapsed_s}. Empty dict when no agent run is active. Populated by EngineClient on AGENT_BEAT events.

last_message_role.doc: Role of the most recent session message ('' if empty, else 'user'|'assistant'|'system'|'tool'). Maintained by EngineClient via SessionManager.on_messages_changed so Python TUI clients (Rich, Textual) never need to scan session.messages for interrupt/alternation checks. Not currently in SSE_SYNC_FIELDS — web/VSCode do their own message tracking.
